_meta.description: Per-file provenance vs HestiaCP. A file listed with source_type 'eigenbau' is HestiaRE-native. Recompute is a manual, occasional job (when we cherry-pick or reintegrate from upstream); numbers are a snapshot at each file's upstream_ref + measured_at, not live.
_meta.divergence_method: churn = (added+removed)/(upstream_lines+our_lines)*100, from a line diff between the two blobs. RAW: includes the mechanical v-*->h-* rename + path churn (install/->share/, CONF_DIR, func/->include/), so it OVERSTATES semantic divergence. Triage, not truth.

source_type_values.verbatim: Near-unchanged upstream file (churn <=3%; only rename/path shims).
source_type_values.cherry-pick: Isolated upstream bugfix taken directly. Manual promotion - not auto-detectable from churn.
source_type_values.eigenbau: HestiaRE-native, no upstream counterpart. May carry an inspiration note.

_meta.folder_note: Upstream calls this directory func/; HestiaRE renamed it to include/ because it holds sourced libraries, not only functions. The upstream_path fields below therefore all read func/*, and the rename itself is part of the raw churn.

upstream_files_not_adopted.func/remote.sh: REST API is a permanent ground-rule exclusion - nothing to port.
upstream_files_not_adopted.func/upgrade.sh: No update/migration paths before v1 (no production instances), so there is no upgrade library to carry.
upstream_files_not_adopted.func/internal/dns_record_validator.php: No bundled DNS server (bind9 is a ground-rule exclusion), so no DNS record validation.

files.note: Backup format is bidirectionally compatible with HestiaCP forever, so this stays close to upstream on purpose.
No DNS half (bind9 excluded); web/mail template handling reworked for the Caddy/nginx/apache model.
Effectively eigenbau: upstream ships 25 lines, this is the 685-line nftables renderer (#495). Kept mapped rather than relabelled so the upstream path stays findable.
Carries the HestiaRE input hardening (single-eval object parser, source_conf, validator char classes) and the BIN/SBIN/CONF_DIR anchors.

Own dependency-free DOMDocument allow-list sanitizer (#471); upstream's counterpart is a 19-line wrapper around a bundled library we rejected. Lived in func/internal/ until the subdirectory was dissolved.
Key registry + repair model reworked (#654: an empty value no longer counts as present).
Per-user Docker (#389); upstream has no counterpart.
Jail rendering as a modular addon (#525).
Installer helpers (hestia_apt, load_os_profile, seed_hestia_etc); the whole installer was rebuilt from scratch, no upstream path.
Web model (nginx / both / apache-only) keyset and switch (#120).
Manifest-driven install wizard; upstream has no interactive wizard.
